scope: Direct operations and local helpers of four structural methods, JNI decode hooks, plus explicitly marked alternatives. Retained ART service internals and replaceable diagnostic/logging helpers are outside this inventory. Exact names only; no disassembly or addresses. Phase 3C adds explicitly cataloged standard entry, mapping and method-access services with fixed Android 16 declarations.

sourceGroups.note: 13 ObjectArray slots; Handle array, ClassRedefinition vector pointer, 3 vector<bool>; iterator int32 index + holder reference. Must declare from source; no independent helper symbols required.
Getters and ScopedAssertNoThreadSuspension members inline. Require exact Runtime/Jit/Thread declarations, or externally supplied pointers; no address/offset inference.
LengthPrefixedArray/ArraySlice/StrideIterator + ArtMethod::Size(pointer_size), ArtField layout. Class iteration/visitor templates have no required standalone specialization.

GetName/GetNameView/GetSignature/GetTypeDescriptor/GetTypeAsPrimitiveType inline; HasSameNameAndSignature non-inline named comparison. Can compare source-declared DEX ids using existing DexView rather than rely on incidental emitted inline symbols.
Both take std::string_view name, std::string_view type. Do not accidentally call hierarchy-search or DexCache index overload.
Use std::string_view, Signature const&, PointerSize overload. Native-copy policy must tolerate tombstones/deletion/native-to-Java instead of original CHECK assumption.
SetStatusLocked(ClassStatus) is standalone; GetStatus/IsErroneous/IsResolved/IsInitialized inline status predicates.

CopyFields recursion assumes identical old/new superclass chains; deletion/type/static transitions must alter mapping/copy policy. All ArtField::Get{Boolean,Byte,Char,Short,Int,Long,Float,Double,Object} inline; Set*<false> templates. Respect volatility and GC read/write barriers; raw memcpy is not equivalent. Local static helper names do not imply reliable named services.
Object::GetLockWord/SetLockWord inline; WriteBarrier::ForEveryFieldWrite ALWAYS_INLINE card-table access. Require Object/LockWord and GC barrier fixed source declarations.
SetObsoleteObject changes source-defined class access flags. SetIsObsolete and SetDontCompile modify ArtMethod access flags. No independent callable symbol required/guaranteed.

Entry accessors inline. Old native obsolete quick entry must remain untouched for stack-size/walking semantics. Copy only compatible surviving native methods; tombstone/native-to-Java is not matching-native case.
void ClassLinker::SetEntryPointsForObsoleteMethod(ArtMethod*) const. Does not alter native quick entry; non-native uses obsolete invoke stub.

Named Runtime::VisitReflectiveTargets(ReflectiveValueVisitor*); lambda pair is inline template adapter. Fixed virtual ABI: destructor, VisitMethod(ArtMethod*,ReflectionSourceInfo const&), VisitField(ArtField*,ReflectionSourceInfo const&); ReflectionSourceInfo GetType inline. A11 mapping wins before clearing; A13 clears potential shadowing first and searches all reconstructed descendants.
void Instrumentation::DeoptimizeAllThreadFrames(); exclusive mutator held. Keep ART service; do not recreate stack walking.
HeapExtensions::ReplaceReferences(Thread*, const unordered_map<ObjPtr<Object>,ObjPtr<Object>,HashObjPtr>&); exact ObjPtr/HashObjPtr/map ABI required. Keep ART service.
void ClassExt::SetObsoleteClass(ObjPtr<Class>); Class::GetExtData inline. Need retain old Class vector before ReplaceReferences overwrites holder arrays.
void JitCodeCache::InvalidateAllCompiledCode(); conditional on non-null Jit. Clear after replacement and obsolete retention.

Named ThreadList::ForEach(void (*)(Thread*,void*),void*) adapter; InterpreterCache::Clear(Thread*) named. GetInterpreterCache inline fixed Thread field declaration. Guard with Locks::thread_list_lock_ and MutexLock (source RAII wrapper).

ClearAllInterpreterCaches uses RunCheckpoint, which explicitly asserts mutator lock NOT exclusively held and may queue asynchronous callbacks for running threads. Original commit exclusively holds mutator lock and clears synchronously. Not a drop-in; would require a proven transaction sequence change.

Heap::VisitObjects is ALWAYS_INLINE template in heap-visit-objects-inl.h, not independently required named service. Possible named ClassLinker::VisitClasses(ClassVisitor*)/VisitClassesWithoutClassesLock with fixed virtual visitor; must preserve class-def pause, filters, subtype completeness and lock ordering. VisitClasses enumerates registered class tables rather than all heap Class objects; completeness for live obsolete/temp classes is not established.

Handle/MutableHandle/StackHandleScope/VariableSizedHandleScope declarations + scope registration/source sizes; ObjectArray<Class>::Alloc/Get/Set/Iterate templates and Array allocation. CompareClasses local helper compares GetSuperClass chains; no needed named comparison symbol. Old/new ancestry change requires re-plan topology.

jvmti::ClassRedefinition::GetNewClassSize(ClassAccessor&) existing wrapper is named candidate; Class::ComputeClassSize inline. ClassAccessor field iterator + DexFile string/type accessors templates/inline must have fixed source declarations, or own DEX parse.
ClassLinker::AllocClass(Thread*,uint32_t); Class::SetDexCache(ObjPtr<DexCache>) standalone. Cache->GetDexFile inline; DexFile::GetClassDef inline fixed DEX declarations.
SetupClass(DexFile const&,dex::ClassDef const&,Handle<Class>,ObjPtr<ClassLoader>); LoadClass(Thread*,DexFile const&,dex::ClassDef const&,Handle<Class>). New class invisible in ClassTable.

ObjectLock<Class> template delegates Object MonitorEnter/Exit; fixed handle and class declarations needed. A11 copies WasVerificationAttempted (removed A13). A11 Finish sets DexCache::SetResolvedType for new class (removed A13). Interface changes require more than supplied superclass: original allocation assumes interfaces unchanged.

LinkClass(Thread*,char const*,Handle<Class>,Handle<ObjectArray<Class>>,MutableHandle<Class>*); null descriptor avoids ClassTable publication. Class::SetStatus(Handle<Class>,ClassStatus,Thread*); ForceClassInitialized(Thread*,Handle<Class>). Preserve initialization without rerunning clinit.
Static bool Class::Ensure*Ids(Handle<Class>); preallocation required before no-failure commit point.

A11 ClassLinker::SetEntryPointsToInterpreter(ArtMethod*) const selects interpreter bridge for Java and generic JNI stub for native. A13 Instrumentation::InitializeMethodsCode(ArtMethod*,void const*) with nullptr respects instrumentation entry policy. ArtMethod::SetNotIntrinsic() named standalone.

ClassRedefinition::RecordFailure delegates Redefiner result and message; calling variadic/string helpers depends C++ ABI. Thread assertion methods named; exception get/pending/clear inline Thread state. Diagnostic PrettyClass/PrettyMethod/Dump are non-semantic and can avoid personal values.
Not called by four functions directly; Phase 3 tombstone policy requires both JniIdManager decode services. Runtime visitor already rewrites stored IDs. Do not expand retained JniIdManager internals.

MutexLock RAII ctor/dtor inline delegates named lock/unlock. Locks::thread_list_lock_ is a named static data object. One library set has OEM ExclusiveLock(Thread*,unsigned int) only; A12 official declaration does not explain unsigned semantics. Must not synthesize ABI/default zero.

Original four routines bypass this helper because hierarchy cannot change. DefineClass uses it after LoadClass while status kIdx. Helper resolves new superclass and interface types using current DexCache/table, checks accessibility/direct self-inheritance, sets superclass and kLoaded. Phase4 needs this validation or equivalent named ResolveType and fixed-source checks; batch replacement superclass mapping requires deliberate handling.
Original fields require matching name/type/static; original methods CHECK matching name/signature. Retired targets require revised access semantics; pointer remapping alone cannot make fields throw.
16 unified fields array; classify via ArtField::IsStatic. ArraySlice/LengthPrefixedArray/StrideIterator layouts must use fixed source definitions.
Both 15 and16 std::string_view ABI. Source15 passes char* expressions with implicit conversions; no ABI change here.
Identity reads need ArtField and DexCache/DexFile fixed declarations. Getter metadata has no mandatory independent symbol.
Signature type includes DexFile-backed signature comparison; fixed DexFile declarations or own DEX metadata comparison required.
Non-inline; can instead compare own DEX names/signatures with fixed declarations.
Copy/Clear uses transaction=false; preserve volatile accesses and reference read/write barriers. Source inline/template; accidental emitted instantiations do not cover all 27 libraries.
Static helper symbols optional/optimizer dependent; CopyFields same-name/type CHECK and parallel superclass chain recursion are the behavior own policy must replace.
Copy lock word, reset old object to default, preserve object headers from fixed declarations.
Marks destination/source cards after copy+clear. Fixed Runtime/Heap/CardTable declarations or higher named barrier required; do not omit.
Updates status under exclusive mutator lock; can use named Class::SetStatus(Handle<Class>,ClassStatus,Thread*) only preserving STW constraints.
Sets kAccObsoleteObject through Class access flag field; no required independent symbol.
Set obsolete and non-compilable flags preserving AddAccessFlags atomic behavior and invokable guard.
Must run after method obsolete flag. Reuses ART obsolete entrypoint service.
Original native copy DCHECKs method exists and remains native. Owned mapping must handle deleted native methods/new native flag, cannot blindly copy retired implementations.
Copy only semantically compatible native members while all threads stopped; deletion/tombstones must not inherit obsolete native implementation.
Resolved DexCache values potentially shadowed are cleared; other reflective values mapped. Phase3 modifier/deletion policy may require broader invalidation than original add-only predicate.

Named entry expects fixed virtual ReflectiveValueVisitor/ReflectionSourceInfo ABI; lambda wrapper creates FunctionReflectiveValueVisitor. Retain ART traversal; do not reproduce all reflected object walkers.
Exclusive mutator lock, ART service performs whole-thread frame deoptimization.
Retained ART service; own std::unordered_map uses matching libc++/ObjPtr/HashObjPtr ABI. Does not rewrite ArtMethod*/ArtField*, but alters obsolete declaring_class roots which must be restored.
Restore methods except IsCopied (copied methods retain interfaces as declaring class), and every field. Class visitors templates; ArtField setter runtime/art_field-inl.h:59.
Retain old class/dependencies until JIT and obsolete dex caches safe to collect; Class::GetExtData is inline.
Optional jit != nullptr; before interpreter caches. GetJit/GetCodeCache are inline object-field reads.
Requires thread_list_lock; exported callback overload avoids relying on template symbol.
Thread::GetInterpreterCache ALWAYS_INLINE; version-specific Thread source layout needed if direct cache access.

ThreadList::ClearInterpreterCaches() has exact synchronous STW semantics but not present before16 source. Thread::ClearAllInterpreterCaches uses RunCheckpoint: source16 thread_list.cc:312 AssertNotExclusiveHeld(self) conflicts with exclusive mutator lock held by structural Update; header thread_list.h:120–134 also states it does not wait for running threads. It cannot substitute during owned STW commit.

Fixed source Runtime/Jit/Thread declarations; current redefinition.h prefix does not expose all service objects. Runtime getters are inline class bodies; process Runtime instance global is named data if needed.

Rooting needed during new-class allocation that can suspend. Handle scopes use Thread::PushHandleScope/PopHandleScope inline. No raw pointers held across suspension. ObjectLock<Class> ctor/dtor out-of-line EXPORT template specializations are named services confirmed by symbol audit; Mutex vendor ABI may vary.
Allocates target plus every loaded resolved subclass, topological old-superclass distance order. Own Phase4 topology must use intended new hierarchy and batch dependencies, not old super chain.

Original heap visitation source inline template; compile against fixed heap-visit-objects-inl.h including paused vs runnable semantics. Alternative VisitClasses(ClassVisitor*) may avoid owning GC enumeration when ClassLinker loaded class enumeration equivalence proved.

ObjectArray<Class>::Alloc 3/4 argument members are inline template definitions in object_array-alloc-inl.h:36/54, delegating Array::Alloc<instrumented,fill_usable> in array-alloc-inl.h:119. Separate symbol audit finds emitted Alloc instantiations not universal; absence is expected inline/template behavior, not missing operation. To own Finish use exact fixed source wrappers or retained named Heap::AllocObjectWithAllocator<true,true,SetLengthVisitor> only after verifying full specialization ABI/build configuration; retaining native Finish avoids importing allocation internals. Get/Set/Iterate source-inline templates; holder slots preserve barriers.
16 gains reference bitmap entry count and underlying Class layout changes. Prefer named ClassRedefinition::GetNewClassSize(ClassAccessor&) where ABI proven to delegate size choice to ART.
Use explicit-superclass overload where unchanged-interface semantics sufficient. Whole own allocator needs all following services.
Allocation can suspend; class handle scopes required. New class remains absent class table until retained ART commit.

Non-inline SetDexCache delegates SetFieldObjectTransaction; preserve transaction/read-write-barrier semantics. In checked 15/16 implementation only dex_cache_ field is set, not auxiliary native pointers.
Sets loader, type/classdef indexes and flags before loading.
Allocates/loads fields and methods; exceptions must be checked in Phase4 owner as DefineClass does.

Named LoadSuperAndInterfaces non-universal. Source16 DefineClass:3656, implementation:6665. Requires kIdx status; resolves ancestors/interfaces, checks interface accessibility/direct self cycles, sets Loaded. Alternative fixed-source logic plus named DoResolveType(TypeIndex,Handle<DexCache>,Handle<ClassLoader>) can retain native LinkClass. Pre-resolve external types before ScopedSuspendClassLoading ti_redefine16:2486, reject complete batch cycles and remap parent/interface caches to new versions; class table resolution would otherwise return old classes. LinkClass NonProxyInterfacesAccessor (class_linker.cc16:7183/7198) uses LookupResolvedType(new DEX interface indexes) and computes native iftable/vtable. Native SetupInterfaceLookupTable (7323) verifies IsInterface but does not replace interface accessibility checks.

Pass null descriptor to avoid duplicate class-table insertion. Retains ART layout/vtable/interface computation. LinkSuperClass rejects final/interface/inaccessible supers and malformed hierarchy; whole-batch cycle handling still own policy.
Source original sets kLoaded before LinkClass when hierarchy known unchanged. LoadSuperAndInterfaces handles this for new hierarchy.
Preserves already initialized old-class semantics without rerunning clinit.
Preallocate ClassExt ID arrays before STW; OOM returns false and old batch unchanged.
16 InitializeMethodsCode changes to (ArtMethod*,const void*,PointerSize) at336 and is no longer source public export declaration. Do not assume old mangle universal.
Preserves hiddenapi access flags while clearing intrinsic bits; source cannot be replaced with simple bit mask.
Use fixed Class/DexCache/source types; 16 Class fields/storage drift requires per-source definitions. GetStatus packs subtype bits; status byte assumptions unsafe.

Native ObjectLock<Class> ctor/dtor preferred when symbol present; compiling own source RAII wrapper through named MonitorEnter/MonitorExit is an alternative. Original allocator locks temporary and linked new Class objects.

Fixed source private types: holder has ObjPtr array handle + vector<ClassRedefinition>* + three vector<bool> state sets; Iter has int32 idx then holder reference. All slot accessors inline; must match ART-built libc++ and object-array barriers; no standalone service guaranteed.

Decoders require !jni_id_lock; exact source behavior for direct pointer-vs-index IDs must be preserved when adding retired member guard. These are independent Phase3 hooks, not direct calls from the four studied functions.

Named common non-template DoResolveType confirmed dynsym27/27 separately. Source ResolveType checks cached type before slow path; slow DoResolveType may load Java class and writes cache, converts ClassNotFoundException to NoClassDefFoundError. Preflight external hierarchy before definition pause; topology requires old-to-new parent/interface cache mapping. No manual iftable implementation needed.
Direct getter calls are inline source wrappers; GetClass/GetDexCache perform source-defined GC/read-barrier handling. Object::GetClass returns Class* in inspected source; names do not prove layout.

The base entry and validation services retain their Phase 1-2 role across releases. Method-retirement hooks install only when every exact name resolves; runtime probes then select a source-declared class layout per transaction and affect new invocations of explicit retired concrete class methods. Original allocation, UpdateClassStructurally and deoptimization resume remain native. Partial exact names are research rows, not universal catalog requirements.

commitOrder: copy current status then static fields
copy instance fields and lock words; reset old fields+lock words with barriers
obsolete classes/methods; preserve compatible native implementations; set obsolete entrypoints and DontCompile
restore obsolete declaring_class roots (excluding copied methods)
synchronously clear all thread interpreter caches
